en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow, steep, cobblestone alley lined with old houses and stone or brick walls on both sides. The buildings have tiled roofs and overhanging upper stories, typical of traditional Balkan architecture. At the bottom right there is printed text in Cyrillic and Latin scripts, and a small serial number and initials appear at the lower left.
